definitions.explanation: An area protected from direct sunlight, typically cooler than surrounding areas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{日陰|ひかげ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}もう→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: It's hot, so let's rest in the shade.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日陰|ひかげ}⟦でも→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}ちます→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: This plant can grow even in the shade.

examples.japanese: {日陰|ひかげ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{日向|ひなた}→日向：05044_hinata⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: The temperature is completely different in the shade versus the sun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{日陰|ひかげ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{停|と}めた→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: I parked the car in the shade.

examples.japanese: {日陰|ひかげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}して→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。

notes:
{日陰|ひかげ} specifically refers to shade from sunlight, as opposed to general darkness.

Contrast with:
- {日向|ひなた} (sunny spot, place in the sun) - opposite
- {影|かげ} (shadow, silhouette) - shadow cast by an object
- {陰|かげ} (shade, behind) - can also mean 'behind' or 'unseen'

Common expressions:
- {日陰|ひかげ}に{入|はい}る (to get into the shade)
- {日陰|ひかげ}で{育|そだ}つ (to grow in the shade)
- {日陰|ひかげ}{者|もの} (person who avoids the spotlight)
